steps.do: Verify the customer's identity only if it is not already verified and you need to open their records. Get any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone, address. Check them with get_user_information_by_*, then call log_verification with the time from get_current_time. Verify only once per conversation.
steps.if: customer not yet verified in this conversation and records must be accessed
steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity using standard procedures.

steps.do: Confirm whether the customer means the personal Platinum Rewards Card or the Business Platinum Rewards Card
steps.quote: Submit the application through your online dashboard or with assistance from a commercial lending specialist; include accurate contact information for follow-up.

steps.do: Explain the personal Platinum Rewards Card terms: minimum credit score $750, annual fee $200.00, purchase APR 16.99% (variable), 10.0% cash back, 0% foreign transaction fee, and a $150.00 annual fee rebate when spend reaches $7500.00 in every monthly window
steps.if: card is the personal Platinum Rewards Card

steps.do: Call get_current_time. Mention the first-year annual fee waiver only if today falls within 2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31. Otherwise the standard $200.00 annual fee applies.
steps.if: customer asks about the annual fee or promotions
steps.quote: Submit your application within the promo window and be approved.

steps.do: Ask for annual income and whether the customer has an active Rho-Bank+ subscription, if they have not said
steps.quote: Complete the online application with your personal information and income details

steps.do: Tell the customer the application is self-service. The agent has no tool to submit it for them, so they submit it themselves with apply_for_credit_card. Tell them which arguments to use.
steps.quote: Complete the online application with your personal information and income details

steps.do: The customer submits the credit card application

args.rho_bank_subscription: whether the customer has an active Rho-Bank+ subscription

steps.quote: Submit the application and, if approved, activate your card upon receipt to begin using it.

steps.do: After the customer submits, explain next steps: if approved, activate the card when it arrives, add it to a digital wallet, and set up alerts and autopay
steps.quote: Activate your card as soon as it arrives, then add it to your digital wallet for immediate use.

rules.rule: No internal procedure or agent-discoverable tool exists for submitting a credit card application. The customer applies themselves with their own apply_for_credit_card tool. The agent must not invent a submission tool or unlock an unrelated one.
rules.quote: Complete the online application with your personal information and income details

rules.rule: The personal Platinum Rewards Card requires a minimum credit score of 750
The personal Platinum Rewards Card annual fee is $200.00. The first-year fee is $0.00 only for applications approved between 2024-06-01 and 2024-12-31.
rules.quote: Apply during the promo window and, if approved, your first year annual fee is $0.00 instead of $200.00.

rules.rule: The promo waiver cannot be applied retroactively to accounts opened outside the window
rules.quote: The waiver cannot be retroactively applied to accounts opened outside the promo window.

rules.rule: The Business Platinum Rewards Card has different requirements: personal credit score of at least 765 and PAYDEX of at least 77 for established businesses
The annual fee rebate requires the spend threshold to be met in every monthly window of the cardmember year. It does not apply in a year whose fee was waived by promo.
rules.quote: A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.

jobs.done_when: The customer knows the agent cannot submit the application for them, knows the card's terms, and has submitted apply_for_credit_card themselves with the card type, their full name, annual income and subscription status (or has decided not to apply).

documents.why: Personal Platinum Rewards Card terms: minimum credit score $750, annual fee $200.00, APR 16.99%, limits $25,000-$150,000, steps after approval
First-year annual fee waiver window (2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31) and its conditions
10.0% earning, $150.00 annual fee rebate at $7500.00 monthly spend, 0% foreign transaction fee
Business Platinum card with a similar name and different requirements; reason to confirm which card the customer means
Shows that card applications are online self-service with personal and income details
Self-service application and post-approval activation wording

open_questions: No internal document describes an agent-run credit card application or names a discoverable tool for one. The workflow relies on the customer's built-in apply_for_credit_card tool.

The personal Platinum Rewards Card documents do not say whether a Rho-Bank+ subscription is required. Only the Gold Rewards Card states it is. The customer should report their subscription status accurately in the rho_bank_subscription argument.
The documents do not say whether existing cardholders face limits on holding more than one personal card.
